title.full: Silver Support: no need to apply

summary.text: No need to apply. CPF Board checks every year, and eligible seniors receive Silver Support every quarter.

details.heading: How you will know
details.body: If you qualify, CPF Board sends you a notification in December, before the year you receive it.

sources.page_title: Do I need to apply for the Silver Support Scheme?

quotes.text: There is no need to apply for the Silver Support (SS) Scheme.
CPF Board will automatically review your eligibility for the SS Scheme every year. Eligible seniors will automatically receive SS every quarter.
Seniors who qualify will receive a notification from CPF Board in December of the preceding year.
